name: COMB TOOTH

plan.note: share of the old 100-bag split; scaled to the 130-bag run, split not yet confirmed

blurb: DENSE, FRACTAL, SELLS WELL. WANTS WARMER THAN THE 16 °C ROOM.

overview.v: Grows out as a column, then branches repeatedly like Romanesco cauliflower, teeth hanging underneath. Dense, cloud-like heads.
Treated nearly identically in culture. Denser, auto-fruits later, so better behaved as spawn.
HcFF, wild collection from Denmark. Stable, vigorous, keeps producing in warmer conditions where lion's mane tapers off.
Wild season Aug-Oct (north). Fruits better in warm months.
Sells as a crab-cake substitute. Liked by retail and wholesale customers.

cultivation.v: Straight combo pellets, 50:50 soy hulls : sawdust. 60:40 also called ideal; wording ambiguous.
61-62% final, counting the roughly 7% already in the pellets. Water pools above about 62%.
1:20: one 6 lb grain bag per twenty 10 lb blocks.
3 rye : 1 sorghum, or pure millet (preferred for masters).
Malt yeast agar. Growth visible in about 3 days.
Like lion's mane: fold bag, cut an X, slit or H, or leave in the bag to fruit from the top.

timeline.v: Full plate in 2-2.5 weeks (3-3.5 if cold).
About 1-1.5 weeks, shake, then 1-1.5 weeks more.
2-2.5 weeks. Stop at about 2 weeks if going to storage.
Denser and faster than lion's mane. Textbook t21 gives no figure.
Card t24 says about 10 days. The number-book chapter t21 says no figure. Treat 10 days as unconfirmed.
About 5-7 days of branching after pins. Pick before it droops and turns spongy.

climate.v: 19 °C (66 °F) on the bag exterior, 18 °C (64-65 °F) supply air.
Prefers about 19-21 °C (upper 60s °F). Tolerates 10-15 °C (the 50s °F). The 16 °C fruiting room sits in the gap between the two.
Browns in too much air, goes popcorny in stagnant air.

yield_.n: Textbook: not stated for comb tooth (F18-0212).

yield_.v: 2.03 lb/block aggregate, Feb-Jun 2026 (plan 2.0 lb). Matches blue.
Yield up 27% and 6 days faster when outdoor temperature was 65 °F or more.

hazards.v: One grower saw no blotch, Trichoderma or odd growth. An occasional patch fails to fractalize.
Browning means too much air. Popcorn growth means stagnant air.

notes.v: Blocks lie on their sides on wire shelves, often beside golden oysters. Heads are large, white and coral-like.
Do not sell spawn that is auto-fruiting. It auto-fruits about half a week later than lion's mane.
